notes: PHASE 1 FEASIBILITY CHECK ONLY -- STOPPED BEFORE BACKTEST, per instructions. No usable analyst-estimate data source exists in this project for this trial. Checked: (1) .env / requirements.txt for existing integrations -- only FMP_API_KEY is analyst-estimate-adjacent; no IBES/Refinitiv/FactSet/Zacks/Estimize configured. Tiingo (this project's primary vendor) does not offer analyst estimates at any tier. (2) Live-tested FMP's current subscription against its 'stable' API: grades-historical and analyst-estimates endpoints both return HTTP 402 'this value set for symbol is not available under your current subscription' for every small/mid-cap ticker tested (SMTC, PLAB, CENT, UFPT, VIAV) -- i.e. small/mid-cap symbol coverage is walled off by plan tier, not merely thin, confirming (and sharpening) the hypothesis's own premise before a backtest could even be attempted. (3) Even for AAPL (large-cap, accessible under current plan), analyst-estimates returns only a live forward-looking snapshot (current consensus for future fiscal years, e.g. FY2030) with no historical vintage/publish-date field -- not a point-in-time revision series usable for a 2015-2020 backtest. grades-historical is capped at limit=10 records total under current plan (402 above that) -- nowhere near enough history even for large caps. (4) SIDE FINDING, separate from this trial: dcf/valuation/sources.py fetch_fmp() (used by run_reconcile.py and portfolio/web.py) calls FMP's v3 endpoints (income-statement, balance-sheet-statement, cash-flow-statement), which now return 403 'Legacy Endpoint -- no longer supported ... only available for legacy users with valid subscriptions prior August 31 2025.' This is a pre-existing production break unrelated to S14; flagged for separate follow-up, not fixed here. VERDICT: kill before backtest, same disposition as Russell reconstitution's initial data-sourcing problem but worse -- Russell was solvable from free archived PDFs; analyst estimates have no free/already-configured path in this project, and the one paid vendor connected (FMP) excludes the exact universe (small/mid-cap) the hypothesis targets, at the currently-held plan tier. Upgrading FMP tier was not attempted (would require user to authorize a new paid subscription cost) -- flagging as an open item for the user's decision rather than assuming they want to pay for it.
